# HomerDev

> The Homer Development Kit: shared code, templates, build and release scripts, checks, skills and subagents for building Windows programs, documents, books, databases, installers and spoken tutorials for screen reader users.

Start with AGENTS.md. Each skill below is a folder under .claude/skills holding a SKILL.md.

## For agents

- [AGENTS.md](AGENTS.md): what the kit is, how to use it from another project, the folder map, which skill to read for which task, and the rules
- [Plugin manifest](.claude-plugin/plugin.json): the kit as a Claude Code plugin
- [homer-auditor](.claude/agents/homer-auditor.md): a subagent that audits projects against the kit
- [homer-listener](.claude/agents/homer-listener.md): a subagent that reviews tutorial reader lines

## Skills

- [app-help-guide](.claude/skills/app-help-guide/SKILL.md): build a screen-reader-friendly help guide for a product from the publisher's own help pages
- [blind-creators](.claude/skills/blind-creators/SKILL.md): add, verify or remove a person or work in the Blind Authors, Developers, Presenters or Creators directories
- [homer-books](.claude/skills/homer-books/SKILL.md): build, audit and publish Kindle books with the kit's book tools
- [homer-build-release](.claude/skills/homer-build-release/SKILL.md): run or troubleshoot build, check, tidy, push and release, and read their logs
- [homer-code](.claude/skills/homer-code/SKILL.md): write or review code in Camel Type with the kit's shared classes
- [homer-convert](.claude/skills/homer-convert/SKILL.md): convert documents and data between formats, writing the Homer encoding
- [homer-db](.claude/skills/homer-db/SKILL.md): design or check a SQLite database the way DbDo opens it
- [homer-docs](.claude/skills/homer-docs/SKILL.md): write or review an app's documents at a ninth-grade reading level
- [homer-elevate](.claude/skills/homer-elevate/SKILL.md): add or fix F11, Elevate Version, the update check
- [homer-installer](.claude/skills/homer-installer/SKILL.md): write or fix an Inno Setup installer and its finish page
- [homer-migrate](.claude/skills/homer-migrate/SKILL.md): bring an existing app onto the kit, or audit one that has drifted
- [homer-new-app](.claude/skills/homer-new-app/SKILL.md): start a new app from the kit's templates
- [homer-page](.claude/skills/homer-page/SKILL.md): publish a document as an accessible GitHub Page
- [homer-screen-reader](.claude/skills/homer-screen-reader/SKILL.md): write or install JAWS scripts and NVDA add-ons
- [homer-tutorial](.claude/skills/homer-tutorial/SKILL.md): write or check the spoken walkthroughs, where a host works and a screen reader answers
- [homer-ui](.claude/skills/homer-ui/SKILL.md): design dialogs, menus, keys and speech for screen reader users
- [podcast-directory](.claude/skills/podcast-directory/SKILL.md): build a screen-reader-friendly directory of a podcast from its RSS feed

## Documents

- [HomerDev guide](help/HomerDev.md): the kit for the people who use it
- [Developer guide](help/Developer.md): how the kit is built and extended
- [Finish page](help/FinishPage.md): the installer pattern every app follows
- [Logging](help/Logging.md): what every log records
- [Inix](help/Inix.md): the settings format
- [Book pattern](help/BookPattern.md): the book publishing projects
- [Camel Type for C#](help/CamelType_CSharp.md), [for Python](help/CamelType_Python.md), [for JAWS script](help/CamelType_JAWSScript.md): the coding style
- [History](help/History.md): every change, newest first
